frequency_question: How often do central banks successfully implement an incremental reserve ratio instrument when structural resistance or administrative friction is present within the window?
membership_rule: Includes all documented proposals or sudden deployments of incremental/special cash reserve ratios or equivalent secondary reserve requirements by major emerging market central banks facing liquidity overhangs. Excludes standard adjustments to baseline policy rates or permanent structural reserve requirement changes.

skeleton: Identified major emerging market central bank interventions involving secondary liquidity-absorbing reserve mandates over a 20-year period, categorized by whether institutional friction prevented execution within the designated announcement window.
